question: The binding vocabulary has no term for a paid floor (a monthly minimum charge) or a time-limited signup credit. The CrunchyData and DigitalOcean Managed Databases drafts use binding none because no usage quota binds a paid-only or credit-only offer; what term should name a cost-based constraint?
why: A paid floor and a 90-day expiring credit are the real constraints on these offers, but request-rate, pull-count, per-ip-shaping, per-object-cap, write-gated, retention-clamped and volume-quota do not describe them.
